channel.title: Rippling Identity (IAM) Launches
channel.description: Latest product launches for IT admins (scope: it-iam)

item.title: Google Workspace Offboarding v2
item.description:
Advanced policy management -- Create, update, duplicate, archive, and reorder offboarding policies by priority Safer policy iteration with full version history and restore capabilities
Simulation & admin confidence -- Simulate mode to preview user-level offboarding actions before execution Helps admins validate policies and build trust before enabling automation
Comprehensive visibility & audit tracking -- Offboarding Activity records with user-level and action-level status tracking -- Clear error messages with manual retry controls for failed actions -- Policy changelog tracking who changed what and when

item.title: SSO Improvements (BDR, error msg)
item.description:
When configuring a BDR policy where Action = Block sign-in (for all apps or specific apps), admins can now:
-- Add a custom message per policy -- Use a rich text editor (formatting + hyperlinks supported) -- Include links to resources (e.g., security training in LMS) -- Preview the message before saving -- Override the default fallback message (fully backward compatible)
This works for both: -- Editing existing BDR policies -- Creating new BDR policies
Users who are blocked will now see the configured message during SSO instead of a generic error.

item.title: SSO Latency Improvements
item.description: Rearchitected network requests resulting in a 50% reduction in median latency

item.title: Bulk 3P Group Push Bug Fix
item.description: Bug fix -- Fixed an issue where landing groups in a stuck state

item.title: API latency improvements
item.description:
API performance improvements -- Improved latency across APIs impacting critical user workflows -- Enhancements apply to SSO login, individual and group assignments, SCIM/SAML setup, and offboarding
Faster identity and provisioning workflows -- Achieved ~20–25% average latency reduction across affected endpoints -- Delivered 50–88% improvements in key flows including AD provisioning, SSO login, and integration group assignments

item.title: Improvements to Slack integration
item.description:
Improved Slack integration & reauthorization -- Introduced modern OAuth reauthorization for Slack Enterprise Grid -- Enables org-level reconnection with the correct permissions for user lifecycle events -- Resolves issues with reactivation scenarios such as start date changes, rehires, and post-deactivation access
Enhanced Slack SSO setup experience -- Dynamic setup instructions tailored to the customer’s Slack plan (Enterprise Grid vs Pro/Business+) -- Step-by-step guidance for configuring SAML, navigating Slack settings, and testing setup -- Replaces outdated one-size-fits-all instructions to reduce confusion and setup errors

item.title: Automating permission updates for Third-party Apps
item.description: Improved App Shop permissions management -- Eliminated the need for one-off permission configuration for non-super admins -- Enable permission profiles to automatically grant install access for new integrations -- Streamlines access control for all newly published third-party App Shop integrations

item.title: RPass Extension Popout
item.description: Enhanced RPass usability -- Open RPass in a dedicated browser window for a more flexible experience -- Enables persistent browsing while viewing and copying credentials

item.title: RPass Dark mode
item.description: RPass extension enhancements -- Added dark mode support for a more comfortable viewing experience
